# Masterstroke Academy

> Online blockchain developer education based in Pune, India. A structured, college-integrated
> programme covering Solidity, Web3, DeFi, smart contract security auditing, ZK proofs and RWA
> tokenisation across 4 phases, 21 modules and 130+ hours. Students deploy to MST Chain, an
> EVM-compatible Layer-1 built for India, and receive an on-chain verifiable certificate.

Operated by Masterstroke Technosoft Pvt. Ltd.
T3, Kohinoor World Towers, Old Pune-Mumbai Highway, Opposite Empire Estate, Pimpri, Pune 411018, Maharashtra, India
support@masterstroke.academy | +91 9112228906 | Mon-Sat 10:00-18:00 IST

## Programme

- [Curriculum overview](https://masterstroke.academy/academy-overview): Full syllabus — 4 phases, 21 modules, 123 submodules. Phase 1 blockchain fundamentals; Phase 2 developer tooling and MST Chain; Phase 3 MVP build including security auditing, DeFi and ZK; Phase 4 grants, pitch and career.
- [Learning tree](https://masterstroke.academy/learn): Interactive module map with in-browser Solidity execution and assessments. A 70% score is required to unlock each subsequent lesson.
- [Leaderboard](https://masterstroke.academy/leaderboard): Learner rankings; top performers are eligible for fellowship bonuses and pre-placement offers.

## Outcomes

- Job-ready blockchain engineer: write, test, audit and deploy Solidity contracts; build full-stack dApps with wallet integration.
- Security and audit specialist: reentrancy, proxy patterns, formal verification, professional audit reports.
- Funded founder: graduate with a live dApp and pitch deck; top capstones may qualify for MST ecosystem grants up to $50,000.
- On-chain credential: certificate recorded on MST Blockchain, verifiable by employers.

## Optional

- Assessment weighting: MCQ and true/false 35%, coding and completion 30%, descriptive and design 15%, projects and practicals 12%, presentations and pitches 8%.
